shard.title: Subject: Protest
shard.basis: the publisher's subject list, from gssrdoc in the current release (7224r3a)

questions.text:
There are many ways people or organizations can protest against a government action they strongly oppose. Please show which you think should be allowed and which should not be allowed by circling a number after each question. 
A. Organizing public meetings to protest against the government.
